meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 它把 Slack 频道接入 Claude:从 channels 分支复制 Slack 适配器并注册、安装指定版本的依赖包、构建并跑一条注册测试,再引导你创建 Slack 应用、填入凭据、重启服务。
howto.when: 当你要求给 Claude 添加 Slack 频道接入时触发;若正处在 /setup 流程中,它会先完成 Slack 接入,再让你回到该流程。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 频道接进来。
say.note: 它会复制适配器并一步步引导你创建 Slack 应用。

say.text: Slack 事件用 Socket Mode 投递,本地没有公网地址。
say.note: 适配器走 Socket Mode,不需要公网 URL。

say.text: 我的 Slack 成员 ID 是 U0123456789,用它开私信频道。
say.note: 它会校验 bot token 并解析出私信频道地址。

howto.what_en: Wires Slack into Claude: copies the Slack adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned package, builds and runs one registration test, then guides you through app setup, credentials, and a restart.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Slack channel integration to Claude; if you're mid /setup, it finishes the Slack wiring first and then returns you to that flow.

say_en.text: Add Slack as a channel for me.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and walks you through app setup.

say_en.text: Use Socket Mode for Slack events, I have no public URL.
say_en.note: Adapter runs in Socket Mode, no public URL needed.

say_en.text: My Slack member ID is U0123456789 for the DM channel.
say_en.note: Validates the bot token and resolves the DM address.
